correctness.rationale: PASS: All-positive labeling forces pairwise disjoint queried exact blocks. If union is all of [n] and one queried block is a singleton, labeling all other queries positive and it negative is impossible. Otherwise a fixed spare vertex can absorb all negative singleton queries while other negative blocks are split, realizing every labeling. Maximal families must either leave one unused vertex or have complete no-singleton cover. Stirling/associated-Stirling exponential formulas count faces and facets; root positive branch fixes a block of size >=1, bounding Littlestone depth by 1+d_(n-1), with VC lower n-1. Fresh independent exhaustive support-trace tests across n<=4 found no discrepancy (32906 total tested cases).
